symptom: A `dataview` in a layout, and a scroll container region with `ToggleMode: 'ShrinkContentInitiallyClosed'` and no `sidebartoggle`, passed check and exec; mx check 11.12.6 reported CE6086 "Data views are not allowed on web layouts." and CE0611 "A sidebar toggle button is required if a region can toggle."
cause: No check-time rule knew which widgets a layout may hold or where a sidebar toggle must be; mxbuild was the first to look.
insight: **Measure the neighbours of the reported shape, not just the shape**: the same mx check run showed CE6086 applies to native layouts too, a toggle in a called snippet does not satisfy CE0611, and a toggle outside the one top-level scroll container is a third error (CE0628) the report never hit. Run describe -> check over every Atlas layout as the false-positive control: all 22 must pass.
